name: Baked Samosa
category: Healthy Indian Snacks and Street Food
ingredients: Dough: ½ cup whole-wheat flour, 1 tsp oil, pinch of salt and ajwain, water
Filling: 1 small boiled potato, mashed, ½ cup green peas, ½ cup cooked chickpeas, mashed
½ tsp each cumin seeds, coriander powder and garam masala
½ tsp amchur and ¼ tsp chilli powder
1 tsp ginger and 1 green chilli, minced
steps: Knead the dough ingredients into a firm dough and rest for 20 minutes.
Heat the oil, crackle the cumin, add ginger, chilli, peas and spices and cook for 3 minutes. Mix with the potato, chickpeas, coriander and salt; cool.
Divide the dough into 4 balls, roll thin into ovals, cut each in half, shape into cones, fill and seal.
Place on a tray, brush with a little oil.
Bake at 200°C for 25 minutes, turning once, until golden and crisp.
note: Baked in a whole-wheat shell rather than deep-fried in refined flour.
